pass_1.finding: The 2010 iCLIP original describes 3′ RNA adapter ligation; RT oligo bearing two inversely oriented adapter regions, BamHI site, sample barcode and 3-nt random barcode; cDNA circularization, BamHI linearization and PCR. The paper explicitly sends readers to Supplementary Methods for detailed oligos; that relevant supplement remains inaccessible. These predecessor constructs are not automatically eCLIP oligos.
